videos.title: Zabardast
videos.description: Ratan steals diamonds for a gangster, Balram Singh, but after learning about the latter's evil intentions, he decides to keep them. Later, believing his family to be dead, Ratan goes on the run.

videos.title: An Evening In Paris
videos.description: A wealthy woman meets a charming but not completely truthful beau in France.

videos.title: Neend Hamari Khwab Tumhare
videos.description: Nishad, who belongs to a noble Muslim family, is in love with Anwar. When everything seems to be working in their favour, a secret from Anwar's family threatens to end their relationship.

videos.title: Haathkadi
videos.description: An inspector hires four juveniles to kidnap a politician as he wants to usurp the minister's property. The juveniles have other plans for the politician, who was responsible for them going to jail.

videos.title: Ghulam
videos.description: Jai runs errands for Ronak Singh who is a gang lord and is involved in illegal activities. Jai's brother Siddharth decides to revolt against him and Ronak after some things goes lethally awry.

videos.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
videos.description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

videos.title: Gardish
videos.description: A peace-loving man has to resort to violence when his father is beaten up by mobsters.

videos.title: Santaan
videos.description: Sarju and Laxmi have done everything to educate their son Amar and have lots of hope from him but the but he desires to become rich and disowns his parents who then face only sufferings in their life.

videos.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
videos.description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

videos.title: Gehri Chaal
videos.description: Shekhar threatens to expose Ratan's secret if he does not help him in a heist. A desperate Ratan assists Shekhar, but ends up becoming the prime suspect.

videos.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
videos.description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

videos.title: Majhdhaar
videos.description: Krishna loves Radha but they cannot marry against their parent's wishes. Although she is pregnant with Krishna's child, circumstances lead Radha to marry Gopal.

videos.title: Gair
videos.description: An abandoned child raised by a wealthy family takes over the family business. He is resented by their natural son who, fueled by a bitter uncle, tries his best to make him lose face.

videos.title: Amanush
videos.description: A village youth falsely implicated in a conspiracy is imprisoned and can't prove his innocence to his beloved. Devastated, he takes to alcohol.

videos.title: Professor Ki Padosan
videos.description: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobha's ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

videos.title: Phool
videos.description: Dharamraaj (Rajendra Kumar) and Balram Choudhary (Sunil Dutt) are two friends who earn their living by farming. To cement their friendship both fathers fix their children's wedding.

videos.title: Jurrat
videos.description: Inspector Avinash is transferred to Mumbai and is tasked to nab smuggler Kama Seth. When Kama hoodwinks Avinash and makes him a laughing stock in the eyes of the media, he makes a dangerous decision.

videos.title: Love 86
videos.description: A strict mother tries to marry off her daughters, Leena and Isha, to two brothers from a well-off family, but they prefer two down-and-out thieves.

videos.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 1
videos.description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

videos.title: Nehlle Pe Dehlla
videos.description: Two small-time crooks, Jimmy and Johny, blackmail hotel manager Balram Sahni aka Ballu in order to get a huge sum of money. But their plan goes haywire when Ballu is mysteriously murdered.

videos.title: Comedy Station - Dr Pran Lele
videos.description: DR PRAN LELE, A quirky, mad-cap doctor - Dr. Pran Lele along with his crazy Nurse CPR is here to provide an abundant dose of LOLs & ROFLs as they treat their celebrity patients in their unique ways.

videos.title: Dard
videos.description: A man takes the blame for a crime he didn't commit to ensure his sister's happiness and safety. When he is released from jail, he learns that the woman he loved is no more.

videos.title: Namak Haram
videos.description: Two young men from vastly different worlds, a Delhi slum and a Calcutta mansion, form a bond that is put to the ultimate test.

videos.title: Kashmir Ki Kali
videos.description: A rich Man, Rajeev falls for the charms of a beautiful but poor flower seller Champa, but the pair must overcome class boundaries to find true love. Starring Sharmila Tagore and Shammi Kapoor.

videos.title: Yakeen
videos.description: A couple meets with a car accident. The husband suffering from amnesia finds evidence, that all had not been well in his previous life. He grows suspicious of the people around him including his wife.

videos.title: Aurat Teri Yehi Kahani
videos.description: Savitri, a motherless girl, is forced to marry an elderly man for her family's sake. However, after her husband's sudden death, her life takes a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Anand Ashram
videos.description: While the Thakur would like to get Deepak to marry a woman from an equally wealthy family, he has fallen in love with a poor woman named Asha, and would like to marry her.
